categories.label: Breakfast
categories.eyebrow: For the sunny side of life

items.name: The slow-morning stack
items.description: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, whipped butter, and a generous pour of maple syrup.

items.name: Two eggs, your way
items.description: A classic plate with crisp potatoes and thick-cut toast.

items.name: The breakfast sandwich
items.description: Egg, cheddar, and a toasted bun. A little messy. A lot to love.

items.name: The counter burger
items.description: A griddled burger with cheddar, pickles, and house-style sauce.

items.name: Golden grilled cheese
items.description: Melty cheddar on buttery toast, with tomato soup for dipping.

items.name: The big chopped salad
items.description: Crunchy greens, seasonal vegetables, and a bright, tangy dressing.

items.name: A slice of pie
items.description: A flaky crust and a little nostalgia. Ask about the day’s slice.

items.name: The classic milkshake
items.description: Vanilla, chocolate, or strawberry. Finished with whipped cream.

items.name: One more coffee
items.description: A simple cup for good conversation and unhurried mornings.
